jobs.title: Engineering Manager DevEx & Front end Platform
jobs.description:
**Wat ga je doen?**
-------------------

Als Engineering Manager DevEx & Front End Platform geef je leiding aan drie platformteams en ben je verantwoordelijk voor mensen, delivery en budget. Met jouw technische achtergrond help je richting geven aan de platformen die softwareontwikkeling binnen Jumbo versnellen en vereenvoudigen. Je verbetert de developer experience en onderzoekt hoe automation en AI developers productiever kunnen maken.

### **Aan de slag! Dit ga je doen**

Je geeft leiding aan één Developer Experience-team en twee Front End Platform-teams. De teams werken volgens DevOps-principes en bouwen, beheren en verbeteren de platformen waarvoor zij verantwoordelijk zijn. Jij zorgt voor sterke teams, heldere prioriteiten en voorspelbare resultaten.

Developer Experience staat centraal. Samen met je teams kijk je naar de volledige software development lifecycle en verbeter je processen, tooling en platformen die developers dagelijks gebruiken. Je helpt blokkades wegnemen, automatiseert waar mogelijk en maakt softwareontwikkeling sneller, eenvoudiger en betrouwbaarder.

Je begrijpt software engineering in de breedte en bent een geloofwaardige gesprekspartner voor senior engineers. Je verbindt engineering, Product en Architecture en zorgt dat technische keuzes leiden tot concrete verbeteringen voor developers.

Daarnaast kijk je vooruit. AI-assisted development en agentic engineering veranderen de manier waarop software wordt gebouwd. Jij onderzoekt samen met je teams hoe deze ontwikkelingen kunnen bijdragen aan een betere developer experience binnen Jumbo.

Uiteindelijk draait de rol om één vraag: hoe zorgen we dat developers binnen Jumbo zo effectief mogelijk kunnen bouwen?

Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

* Leidinggeven aan één Developer Experience-team en twee Front End Platform-teams.
* Verantwoordelijkheid voor people management, ontwikkeling en recruitment.
* Verantwoordelijkheid voor delivery, budget en platformresultaten.
    
  Verbeteren van developer experience over de volledige software development lifecycle.
* Richting geven aan platform engineering, cloud, developer tooling en automation.
* Stimuleren van eigenaarschap volgens DevOps-principes.
* AI en automation vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen voor developers.
* De development community vertegenwoordigen richting Product, Architecture en andere technische teams.

### **Samen zijn we Jumbo: hier kom je te werken**

Je werkt binnen Jumbo Tech & Data, waar jouw teams platformen ontwikkelen die andere engineers helpen sneller, consistenter en effectiever software te bouwen. Je werkt nauw samen met developmentteams, Product, Architecture en andere platformteams om softwareontwikkeling binnen Jumbo continu te verbeteren.

**Wie ben jij?**
----------------

* Je hebt ervaring met leidinggeven aan engineers en helpt technische professionals groeien.
* Je hebt een technische achtergrond in software engineering, platform engineering, SRE, distributed systems, infrastructure of system administration.
* Je begrijpt de volledige software development lifecycle en de onderliggende lagen van cloud en infrastructure.
* Je hebt verantwoordelijkheid gedragen voor delivery en begrijpt hoe je technische teams voorspelbaar laat leveren.
* Developer Experience spreekt je aan en je ziet snel waar engineers onnodige technische frictie ervaren.
* Je volgt ontwikkelingen rond automation, AI-assisted development en agentic engineering actief.
* Je bent technisch geloofwaardig, krijgt engineers mee en kunt verschillende technische perspectieven samenbrengen.

**Wat krijg je van ons?**
-------------------------

* Een brutosalaris tussen €6.000 - €7.700 per maand (op basis van 40 uur).
* Een jaarlijkse bonus van max 10% van je jaarsalaris op basis van organisatiedoelstellingen.
* 30 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid tot aan- of verkoop van vakantiedagen) en 8% vakantiegeld.
* Je bouwt pensioen op door deelname aan het Bedrijfstakpensioenfonds voor het Levensmiddelenbedrijf.
* Een (elektrische) leaseauto. We werken graag samen op kantoor, maar je kunt ook deels vanuit huis werken.
* Ruimte voor ondernemerschap, groei en ontwikkeling. Niet alleen in je baan maar ook via onze Jumbo Academy, online trainingen via GoodHabitz en met een opleidingsbudget.
* Een (di)verse lunch in ons Foodcafé, goede koffie en vers fruit. Tegen een kleine vergoeding sport je in onze Jumbo Gym.
* Diverse collega kortingen, zoals 10% korting op je boodschappen (max. € 325 per jaar), deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering en mooie kortingen via Benefits at Work.

Wil je meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden klik dan hier.

**Waarom Jumbo?**
-----------------

"Wat eten we vandaag?" Die vraag hoor je elke dag. En in jouw werk bij Jumbo draag jij bij aan het antwoord op deze vraag. Bij Jumbo werken betekent werken met mensen. Een werkplek waar jij je thuis voelt, jezelf kunt zijn én waar we samen werken aan gezamenlijke doelen. Jouw ideeën om klanten, winkels én collega's blij te maken zijn hier meer dan welkom. Want wij geloven dat onze Jumbo collega's het verschil maken: door wie ze zijn, door wat ze doen én door hoe ze dat doen. Met betrokkenheid, enthousiasme en door het soms nét een beetje anders te doen. En we beloven je, bij Jumbo is geen dag hetzelfde. Er is volop ruimte om te leren en te groeien, zowel vakinhoudelijk als persoonlijk. Waar wacht je nog op? Sluit jij je aan bij onze Jumbo familie? Je bent van harte welkom!

  

* ### **Stuur ons je sollicitatie**

  Vertel ons wie je bent en waarom je graag bij Jumbo wil werken.

* ### **Kom op 1e gesprek**

  We leren elkaar graag wat beter kennen. Zo ontdekken we of deze baan bij je past.

* ### **E-assessment**

  Een online assessment om je skills te testen.

* ### **Kom op 2e gesprek**

  We gaan wat meer de diepte in en leren elkaar beter kennen.

* ### **Arbeidsovereenkomst**

  We overleggen de voorwaarden en leggen dit vast in je contract.

* ### **Aan het werk!**

  We kijken uit naar jouw eerste dag.

  

#### **Kyon** **Adriaans**

Heb je nog vragen over de vacature? Neem gerust contact met ons op!

kyon.adriaans@jumbo.com

06 - 24 15 16 74

jobs.description:
**(Senior) Software Developer (m/w/d) für .NET-Anwendungen**
============================================================

Ort: Stuttgart Degerloch

14 Gehälter ab dem 2. Jahr

38h / Woche

Die ALH Gruppe auf LinkedIn

Flexible Arbeitszeit und FlexWork

Die ALH Gruppe auf Instagram

**Eine Gruppe. Viele Möglichkeiten.**

Als erfahrenes Versicherungs- und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen verbinden wir seit 1819 Wachstum mit Tradition. Rund 3.200 Mitarbeitende sorgen täglich dafür, dass unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bestens abgesichert sind und einen ausgezeichneten Service erhalten. Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld voller Offenheit, Teamgeist und Rückhalt. Gemeinsam mit dir formen wir aus unseren individuellen Kompetenzen ein starkes Team: die ALH Gruppe. Erfahre hier mehr über uns als Arbeitgeber.

  
  

In der Anwendungsentwicklung sorgen unsere IT-Spezialisten täglich dafür, dass die Dienstprogramme, Datenbanken und Anwendungen zuverlässig und technisch einwandfrei laufen und die Fachbereiche damit bestens arbeiten können. Steige ein in unser erfahrenes und motiviertes Entwicklerteam am **Standort Stuttgart** und entfalte dein Potenzial, je nach deinen persönlichen Skills und Vorlieben, um gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft der Krankenversicherung zu gestalten!

  
  
  
  
**Deine Aufgaben:**

* Design und Implementierung von geschäftskritischen Anwendungen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
* Aktive Mitgestaltung der Modernisierung und des Neuaufbaus unserer Anwendungslandschaft
* Entwicklung von Anwendungen im Frontend- und Backendbereich je nach persönlichen Vorlieben, sowie Definition von technischen Standards und Best Practices
* Übernahme einer zentralen Rolle in agilen Teams – von der fachlichen Analyse über Architekturentscheidungen bis zum Go-Live
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen sowie Beratung bei technischen Fragestellungen und Lösungsdesigns
* Leitung von (Teil-)Projekten sowie fachliche Unterstützung und Mentoring von weniger erfahrenen Entwicklern
  

  
  
**Deine Kompetenzen:**

* Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, einer Naturwissenschaft oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung – z. B. als Fachinformatiker – sowie mehrjährige relevante Berufspraxis
* Fundierte praktische Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Projekten im .NET-Umfeld unter Einsatz von C# sowie gängigen Webtechnologien (z. B. JavaScript, HTML, CSS)
* Wünschenswert: Erfahrung in der Leitung von IT-Projekten und in der fachlichen Führung von Entwicklern
* Erfahrung im Einsatz moderner Integrations- und Laufzeittechnologien wie RabbitMQ und Dapr
* Tiefgehendes Verständnis moderner Software-Architekturen (z. B. eventbasierte Architekturen, Domain-driven Design, verteilte Systeme, Webservices)
* Sicherer Umgang mit Software-Design-Prinzipien und -Patterns (z. B. SOLID)
* Praxis im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Integrationsparadigmen und Schnittstellentechnologien (z. B. REST, JSON sowie auch SOAP/WSDL)
* Erfahrung mit Authentifizierungs- und Sicherheitsmechanismen (OAuth 2.0/OIDC, JWT)
* Know-how im effizienten Einsatz von KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen (z. B. zur Unterstützung bei Analyse, Implementierung und Qualitätssicherung)
* Ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen sowie strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
* Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Teamgeist, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und nicht zuletzt sicheres Deutsch (mindestens C1-Niveau)
  

  
  
**Unser Versprechen:**

* **Attraktive Vergütung**: Vierzehn Monatsgehälter ab dem 2. Jahr der Betriebszugehörigkeit

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (C# / .NET, Vue, Azure)
jobs.description:
We're building the OS for the digital workspace: strategic transformation supported by data from the edge, day-to-day operations automated at scale, and end user devices deployed anywhere in the world at the click of a button.

The platform is being built now. What you write will be in production quickly and used by named enterprise customers, rather than sitting in a backlog.

This is a hands-on build role. A handful of engineers own the whole platform, so you will own features end to end: schema, API, front end, deployment, and whatever breaks at 4pm on a Thursday. There's no separate platform team, so you'll see your work all the way through — with the rest of the team alongside you.

What you'll do

–Build front-end and back-end features on our core stack: C# / .NET, TypeScript, Vue, SQL Server, Azure

–Design and consume APIs, and integrate third-party platforms so they hold up in production

–Build and maintain our Azure services (App Services, Functions, Storage) using infrastructure as code (Bicep), and tune the database for performance and reliability

–Build and maintain our CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (there's no separate DevOps team), and ship deployments that don't need a rollback

–Write unit tests with real coverage that hold up beyond the happy path

–Monitor logs, alerts, and error reporting, and fix infrastructure problems before a customer reports them

–Use AI coding tools (we use Claude Code) to move faster, and review every line of the output before it lands

What we're looking for: We are not fixed on years of experience. We are fixed on whether you can build and run production software on this stack.

–Strong C# / .NET and TypeScript, with solid Vue experience

–SQL Server: you can model data properly and diagnose a slow query yourself

–Hands-on Azure experience in a production environment

–Git and Azure DevOps

–Code that is structured, secure, and right-sized for the problem, and you know where that balance sits

–Comfortable being one of a handful of engineers, with the autonomy and the exposure that comes with it

–Strong communication and collaboration. You explain your thinking clearly, work well with people outside engineering, and own your mistakes as readily as your wins

–UK-based, with the existing right to work in the UK. This role is remote within the UK only. We are not able to sponsor visas or employ from outside the UK.

Nice to have

–Charting libraries, particularly eCharts

–End-user computing or IT support background, which gives you the context for what we're building

–A portfolio or public repos we can look at

How we work

Fully remote across the UK, with the whole team getting together at head office every so often, and we'd want you to enjoy that side of it too. Small team, short decision chains, no layers to route around. You will talk directly to the people who use the product and to the people who sell it. We back new tools and frameworks where they earn their place, and we'd want you making the case for the ones you think we should adopt.

Pay: £45,000.00-£75,000.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Are you currently based in the UK?
* Do you have the right to work in the UK without visa sponsorship, now and for the duration of employment?
* How many years of commercial experience do you have with C# / .NET?
* How many years of commercial experience do you have with Vue (2 or 3)?
* Have you built, managed, and deployed applications to Azure infrastructure?
* Which of these have you used in a production role? (Azure DevOps / SQL Server performance tuning / CI-CD pipeline ownership / eCharts or similar charting library)
* Briefly: describe a production incident you diagnosed and fixed yourself.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

experience, or

experience, or

jobs.title: Heating System Design Engineer (Field)
jobs.description:
##### **Upgrade Your Career With Aira**

Clean-energy tech leads to a positive global transformation. Heating homes contribute to 15% of Europe's CO2 emissions. Switching to sustainable solutions offers households a way to achieve net-zero emissions.

Aira's mission is to advance the next generation of home energy solutions, creating intelligent, sustainable homes for a meaningful impact. Starting with innovative heat pumps, it will evolve into a comprehensive, intelligent clean energy-tech system and include dynamic electrical tariffs, cutting-edge home solar systems, and advanced battery storage solutions.

##### **About the role as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

The survey/design visit is a key aspect of the customer journey to ensure an installation goes ahead as planned, and as the customer expects. You will find solutions to problems, ensure the project works in the interests of both the customer and Aira, and provide excellent customer service along the way. You will have the technical expertise to offer additional products and services we may offer in the interests of the customer.

##### **What you’ll be doing as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* Have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.
* Gather information from the quote, property and your survey data to generate an accurate heat loss calculation and emitter output requirements
* Find solutions to any technical issues where possible to ensure an installation can still go ahead
* Report any issues which may affect installation to your line manager from the customers property.
* Keep up to date with all manufacturer's guidance, and any legislative changes including but not limited to heat pumps, low carbon heating, clean energy, and building regulations.
* Operate within required Aira’s efficiency guidelines as well as MCS etc.

##### **What might a day look like?**

* Attend customer properties in your designated area
* Conduct a site survey and collect data relevant to the installation requirements
* Carry out a room by room heat loss assessment
* Determine which radiators need to be replaced, and communicate this with your customer
* Answer any technical queries the customer may have
* Communicate any price changes with the customer and explain the reason for these
* Obtain approval from the customer for your proposal to go ahead
* Create a list of materials required for the installation to be carried out

##### **What you'll need to have as Heating System Design Engineer at Aira**

* You'll need to have the necessary qualifications, training, and experience to design high quality air source heat pump installations for domestic properties.

The following would be useful to have;

* Qualifications in System design such as Heat Geek Heating Mastery
* Level 3 Award in installation and maintenance of air source heat pump systems
* Water regulations certificate (WRAS) course
* Level 2 / 3 Award in plumbing
* Level 3 Award Low temperature heating and hot water systems in dwellings

**What is in it for you?**

* **Salary of £42,000**
* 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
* Health Cash Plan
* Reward Gateway (shopping discount)
* Life insurance
* 25 days Annual Leave plus Bank Holidays
* iPad, Phone and all equipment provided

*(We encourage early applications as we may close the role once we find the right candidate.)*

At Aira, We’re not just champions of next-generation energy, we’re champions in Diversity and Inclusion too. We believe that a diverse workforce sparks innovation and creativity and enables us to better serve our customers and communities. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives to join our team. We will never accept any form of discrimination and believe that together, we can drive a new era for our people and planet.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

**The Team**  
  
The Engineering team at FundApps is a team of ca. 50 smart, friendly people who collaborate closely and take pride in delivering best-in-class software and providing an extraordinary experience to our clients. We’re solving some of the most challenging problems in financial services - we operate in petabytes and milliseconds, not optimising the upload of cat photos. Our clients use our service for multiple hours a day - what we do as engineers has a real life impact on thousands of people across the globe!

Our team values are professionalism, sustainability, and psychological safety; we hold each other to high standards, give each other considered and constructive feedback, work smart, and look out for each other. Learn more about our engineering culture here.

  

### **What You'll Be Working On**

**The Role**

As part of the engineering team, you'll be working on a suite of innovative products that monitor over US$20 trillion in assets under management every single day, used by some of the world's largest Investment Managers. We are looking for a Mid-Level Back End Engineer who can help drive innovation and deliver great software at pace while also keeping sustainability in mind. We need highly motivated, intelligent people hungry for a challenge.

At FundApps, you'll see the inner workings of a fast-growing, bootstrapped scaleup where we expect all Engineers to take responsibility for their part in our success, seek support when needed, and care equally about our products and client outcomes as you do about writing code. We solve business problems through technology, not just ship code.

We like keeping our tech stack modern and are not afraid to invest to keep it cutting edge! As such we’ve recently completed major projects which included distributing our main rules engine using AWS services, migrated terabytes of data from SQL server to Aurora Postgres, replaced our Single Sign On service with Auth0 and converted our frontend to React.

**Our Tech Stack**

* Back-end: C#
* Data storage: PostgreSQL; Amazon storage including Aurora, DynamoDB, S3
* Infrastructure: Terraform and AWS, using Fargate, Lambdas, Step functions, and a lot more!
* Pipeline: GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Octopus Deploy, Serverless
* Front-end: React, TypeScript

  

### **What You'll Bring To The Team**

FundApps engineers have a lot of freedom to solve problems in a way that achieves our outcomes, and works within our values. You will not be micro-managed - in fact, it's the opposite - you will be expected to take ownership of your work from Day 1. To thrive at FundApps, you will need to be comfortable with uncertainty, and embrace change as it comes. We value people who take charge of their destiny and help make things better for everyone around them. We release software when it's ready, not on a schedule - our teams deploy multiple times a day.

We work agile, but do not follow any approach blindly - we seek 1% improvements in everything we do, try new things but don't hold to anything too tightly. Fundamentally, we follow a Kanban-inspired approach, but we also take inspiration from Team Topologies, 12-factor, DevOps culture - and all the good agile practices that you have read about. At FundApps we put these practices to work, reflect, and iterate to make sure our practices continue to serve us well.

Our Engineers look after a wide set of products and technical services; we don't strictly follow a micro-services approach, however we are working over time to evolve our codebase and our core technology to be distributed, cloud-native and resource- and cost-effective to power our growth while doing our bit to help FundApps be carbon neutral.

  

* **Background:** You are a mid engineer with generalist knowledge of product development concepts (software design, product requirements, work breakdown) and agile practices (TDD, CI/CD, architecture) and can apply them to solve well-defined problems independently and with your team. You are comfortable writing code in C#, Java or Python.
* **Work-with-purpose:** You can articulate the value of your own work in larger projects or team-wide goals. You have the space to own and deliver solutions and are comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving requirements.
* **Have-courage:** You are comfortable asking for and giving feedback. You help others when needed, and participate in debates, brainstorms, and other team conversations regularly. You build good relationships with your colleagues in Engineering, Product, and the wider company and are able to respectfully challenge each other to understand the problem and come up with the best solutions. As a company, we embrace change and the chance of failure.
* **Be-transparent:** As a company, we value and aspire for transparency at all levels; you’ll provide work updates to communicate regularly about progress and blockers and reach out for help when needed.
* **Raise-the-bar:** You seek out opportunities to improve our code, process, and practices; 1% improvements over time improve things for everyone.
* **Do-more-with-less:** You identify and help implement improvements to processes and standards within the team, seek to optimise our workflow, and share ideas for how to automate manual tasks. As a company we try to minimise meetings (we have meeting-free Wednesdays) and default to asynchronous written communication over long multiple person meetings.

  

### **A Few Things To Know Before You Apply**

**Work Eligibility**

We require candidates to have permission to work in the UK without visa sponsorship.

We work hybrid and ask that new FundAppers spend 3 days per week at our shiny London office during their first 6 months, to make the most of getting to know the business and other FundAppers.  
  
After that, our policy is at least 2 days per week in the office to collaborate, connect and enjoy our shared space and team activities.

**Life at FundApps**

Work/life balance with flexible hybrid working

Wellbeing benefits such as private health insurance, life insurance, a flexible stipend and mental health coaching

Matched pension contribution up to 10%

Peer micro-bonuses through Bonusly

£1,000 learning budget each year and unlimited professional development leave

Peer-led ‘Brown-bag lunch’ learning sessions and an annual Learning Festival

25 days holiday leave + an extra day next year if you use it all + an extra day after 3 & 5 years

5 Years @ FundApps - additional 4 weeks paid holiday leave during your 5th year as a FundApper

26 weeks leave for all new parents regardless of gender, location or family structure

❤️ Volunteering leave

Birthday off

We are proud of the diversity of all FundAppers - it makes us strong. We provide flexibility around religious observances and embrace a variety of cultural celebrations! If you’re looking for a workplace where you can just be yourself, you’re in the right place.

**Your Privacy**

Any information you submit through our job application process will be used for the purposes of assessing your fit for a role at FundApps. We may also retrieve and store information from your public social media profiles for the same purpose. By applying for this position, you consent to your data being processed in accordance with the FundApps privacy policy.

  

### **About FundApps**

FundApps is a company powered by experts, with a client community of 1000s and a culture underpinned by ethics. Oh - and we make the best regulatory software so our clients can “get a good night’s sleep now they have FundApps’❃[real client quote]

Many lawyers, ex-regulators, info sec and other experts work for the Certified B Corporation™ that is FundApps. We are all about future-proofing our compliance monitoring and reporting software so we can always monitor the £30trn (and growing) of AuM for the industry’s most active and happy global compliance community [we get top notch NPS + CSAT scores year after year].

Good people, good business, good ethics. We are FundApps.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Junior/Mid Level)
jobs.description:
**Product Engineer – Junior/Mid Level** Build the future of Online Brand Protection with us

Wir suchen einen **Full-Stack Engineer** in Wien mit mindestens **3 Jahren Erfahrung**, der Lust hat, gemeinsam mit uns eine traditionelle Industrie neu zu denken.

Bei **Remove.tech** bauen wir Technologie gegen ein reales Problem: **Fakes, Brand Abuse, Betrug, unerlaubte Produktverkäufe und digitale Markenrechtsverletzungen.**

Unser Ziel ist klar: Wir wollen verändern, wie **Online Brand Protection** funktioniert – weg von alten, langsamen und manuellen Prozessen, hin zu einer modernen, AI-gestützten Produkt- und Technologieplattform.

**Aufgaben**
------------

**Deine Rolle**

Du arbeitest nicht an irgendeinem Nebenprojekt, sondern direkt an unserem **Kernprodukt**.

Du bist Teil des gesamten Produktzyklus:

* **Verstehen**, welche echten Probleme unsere Kunden haben
* **Mitdenken**, wie daraus bessere Produktlösungen entstehen
* **Entwickeln**, testen und verbessern
* **Shippen**, messen und aus Kundenfeedback lernen
* **End-to-end Verantwortung** für Features und Verbesserungen übernehmen

Wir arbeiten sehr nah an unseren Kunden und bauen Lösungen, die im Alltag wirklich gebraucht werden. Unser Anspruch ist es, die **beste Product Experience im Markt** zu liefern.

Unser aktueller Tech Stack

* **Frontend:** React, JavaScript
* **Backend:** C#
* **Datenbanken:** MongoDB, PostgreSQL
* **Weitere Themen:** AI-Tools, Automatisierung, Crawling, Matching, Detection, Data Workflows und Product Operations

Erfahrung mit **Matching Technology** ist **kein Muss**.

Für uns ist wichtiger:

* Du bist **motiviert zu lernen**
* Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein
* Du denkst pragmatisch und produktorientiert
* Du hast Lust, mit moderner Technologie echte Probleme zu lösen

**Qualifikation**
-----------------

**Wen wir suchen**

Wir suchen keine Entwickler, die einfach nur Tickets abarbeiten wollen.

Wir suchen **bold developers**, die:

* mindestens **3 Jahre Erfahrung** in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringen
* sich sowohl im **Frontend** als auch im **Backend** wohlfühlen
* hohe Motivation haben, mit **AI-Tools** zu arbeiten
* moderne Developer Workflows nutzen wollen
* gerne Verantwortung übernehmen
* Dinge lieber **bauen, testen und verbessern**, statt endlos darüber zu diskutieren
* nah am Kundenproblem arbeiten möchten
* Lust haben, eine alte Industrie mit neuer Technologie zu verändern

**Was uns wichtig ist**

Bei uns zählt nicht, ob du schon alles perfekt kannst.

Wichtiger ist, dass du:

* **schnell lernst**
* **klar kommunizierst**
* **Verantwortung übernimmst**
* **pragmatisch arbeitest**
* **hohe Qualität liefern willst**
* **AI und moderne Tools als Vorteil siehst**
* Lust hast, gemeinsam mit einem ambitionierten Team zu wachsen

**Benefits**
------------

**Was wir dir bieten**

Wir stellen dir die Technologie zur Verfügung, die du brauchst, um schnell und gut zu arbeiten.

Dazu gehören:

* **moderne Hardware**
* **alle relevanten AI-Tools und Subscriptions**
* schneller Zugang zu neuen Tools und Workflows
* kurze Entscheidungswege
* direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Foundern, Product und Customer Teams
* echte Verantwortung im Produkt
* die Möglichkeit, Features zu bauen, die direkt bei Kunden im Einsatz sind

Unser Ziel ist es, dir ein Setup zu geben, mit dem du **so schnell wie möglich lernen, bauen und Wirkung erzeugen kannst**.

Das Einstiegsgehalt liegt bei **45.000–55.000 € brutto pro Jahr**, abhängig von Erfahrung, Skillset und Fit.

**Warum Remove.tech?**

Weil wir an einem echten Problem arbeiten.

Online Brand Protection ist eine große, alte und oft noch sehr manuelle Industrie. Wir glauben, dass sie mit **AI, besseren Workflows, moderner Software und mutigen Produktentscheidungen** komplett neu gedacht werden kann.

Wir bauen nicht einfach nur Software. Wir bauen ein Produkt, das Marken dabei hilft, sich online besser zu schützen – schneller, smarter und skalierbarer als bisher.

Wenn du Lust hast, in Wien an einem Produkt mit echter Wirkung zu arbeiten und gemeinsam mit uns eine ganze Industrie zu verändern, dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

jobs.title: Fullstack Software Developer (React / .NET)
jobs.description:
Die meisten Tools im IT-Umfeld sind Stückwerk.  
Unverbunden. Schwer wartbar. Voller Workarounds.

Wir bauen das Gegenteil.

Infravisuals ist eine zentrale Plattform, die Geräte, Systeme und Prozesse in IT-Landschaften zusammenführt – mit Fokus auf Kontrolle, Automatisierung und echte Integrationsfähigkeit. Kein SaaS-Zoo. Kein Vendor-Lock-in. Sondern eine saubere, eigenständig betreibbare Lösung.

Das ist kein „weiterer Job“.  
Das ist Aufbauarbeit.

**Aufgaben**
------------

Du entwickelst nicht Features.  
Du baust ein System, das langfristig Bestand haben muss.

* Architektur und Umsetzung einer skalierbaren Plattform (FE + BE)
* Entwicklung in React (TypeScript) und .NET (C#)
* Aufbau sauberer APIs und stabiler Integrationen
* Entscheidungen treffen, die Jahre später noch tragfähig sind
* Direkter Einfluss auf Produkt, Codebase und technische Richtung

Du bist nicht „ein Dev im Team“.  
Du bist Teil des Kerns.

**Tech Stack**

* Frontend: React (TypeScript)
* Backend: .NET (C#)
* APIs: REST
* Infrastruktur: Self-Hosted / On-Premise Fokus
* Tools: Git, CI/CD Pipelines

**Was hier anders ist**

* Kein Tickets abarbeiten ohne Kontext
* Keine politische Roadmap
* Keine sinnlosen Features

Stattdessen:

* Klare Probleme
* Direkte Nutzer
* Sichtbarer Impact

**Qualifikation**
-----------------

**Dein Profil**

* Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Software Developer (Fullstack)
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in React und .NET
* Erfahrung im Design von skalierbaren Webanwendungen
* Verständnis für Softwarearchitektur und Clean Code
* Erfahrung mit API-Design und Systemintegration
* Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise
* Fähigkeit, Anforderungen schnell in funktionierenden Code zu übersetzen
* Triffst Entscheidungen statt sie aufzuschieben & brauchst keine enge Führung

**Nice-to-have**

* Erfahrung mit DevOps / CI/CD
* Erfahrung mit Self-Hosting / On-Premise Lösungen
* Kenntnisse im Bereich IT-Infrastruktur (Netzwerke, Devices)
* Erfahrung mit Monitoring und Logging

**Benefits**
------------

**Was du bekommst**

* Maximale technische Freiheit
* Direkten Einfluss auf ein wachsendes Produkt
* Kein Overhead, keine Konzernstruktur
* Geschwindigkeit in Entscheidungen und Umsetzung
* Ein Umfeld, in dem Output zählt

**Realität**  
Das hier ist kein „bequemer“ Job.  
Es gibt keine perfekt definierten Tickets.  
Keine fertige Struktur, in die du dich einfügst.

Du baust mit.

Wenn du Stabilität suchst, geh woanders hin.  
Wenn du etwas aufbauen willst, das Bestand hat – dann passt es.

**Rahmen**

* Vollzeit / Teilzeit
* Remote möglich
* Start: ab sofort

**Warum Infravisuals**  
Du arbeitest nicht an einem Feature-Backlog ohne Kontext, sondern an einem Produkt mit klarer Zielgruppe und direktem Kundennutzen. Entscheidungen sind technisch getrieben, nicht politisch.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description:
Basis:

Permanent - Full-time

Area of Interest:

Software Development

Location:

Dubai

**Who we are:**
---------------

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

**Who you are:**
----------------

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Software Developer who will be part of a team who builds a state of the art telematics platform that makes sense of the data collected by custom-built hardware. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

As a Software Developer your key area of responsibility will be writing high-performance Java, Python and Go code and SQL queries to process and store data in real-time, as well as writing JavaScript and TypeScript code to create fast and responsive user interfaces. You will need to work closely with other members of the development and technical teams.

To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a flat organization, highly organized, and able to work well under pressure to respond to fast changing priorities and deadlines. In addition, the successful candidate will have excellent written and oral communication skills, strong analytical skills with the ability to problem-solve to well-judged decisions, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

**How you'll make an impact:**
------------------------------

* Listen and contribute to design discussions and make detailed notes and documenting requirements and technical design.
* Provide guidance to more junior team members, sharing knowledge across the teams.
* Write scalable, high quality and secure software in a variety of programming languages and environments, such as Java, Python, Go, JavaScript, SQL.
* Perform quality assurance by doing peer review, ensuring coding standards are followed, looking for logic errors and other bugs.
* Analyze call stacks, trace files, performance data to troubleshoot and identify the root cause of bugs.
* Participate in development of prototypes, minimum viable products and proofs of concept.
* Provide assistance to our support staff and resellers from a technical perspective. This may be in the form of on-call or ad-hoc questions
* relating to how certain features work or verifying the behaviour by reviewing code.
* Research new language features, frameworks and other relevant technologies and offer recommendations to Leads and senior leaders.
* Assist in defining best practices to be used in the team.
* Provide design documents and documentation to ensure efficient maintenance and code reuse.
* Ensure the functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, realistic implementation schedules and system architecture for each assignment.
* Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotating schedule.

**What you'll bring to the role:**
----------------------------------

* 1 - 5 years of required previous experience in a related field.
* Post-secondary Diploma/Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Knowledge of multiple general purpose programming languages (e.g. C#, Java, Python), as well as experience with Python, Google Compute Engine, and Google BigQuery.
* Working knowledge of Cloud computing experience with GCP, AWS and/or Azure.
* Technical competence using software programs, including, but not limited to, Google Suite for business (Sheets, Docs, Slides).
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and engage with all levels of the organization.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

**Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.**

**How we work:**
----------------

At Geotab in Dubai, we have adopted an onsite working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support in-person work. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

new_jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (C# / .NET, Vue, Azure)
new_jobs.description:
We're building the OS for the digital workspace: strategic transformation supported by data from the edge, day-to-day operations automated at scale, and end user devices deployed anywhere in the world at the click of a button.

The platform is being built now. What you write will be in production quickly and used by named enterprise customers, rather than sitting in a backlog.

This is a hands-on build role. A handful of engineers own the whole platform, so you will own features end to end: schema, API, front end, deployment, and whatever breaks at 4pm on a Thursday. There's no separate platform team, so you'll see your work all the way through — with the rest of the team alongside you.

What you'll do

–Build front-end and back-end features on our core stack: C# / .NET, TypeScript, Vue, SQL Server, Azure

–Design and consume APIs, and integrate third-party platforms so they hold up in production

–Build and maintain our Azure services (App Services, Functions, Storage) using infrastructure as code (Bicep), and tune the database for performance and reliability

–Build and maintain our CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps (there's no separate DevOps team), and ship deployments that don't need a rollback

–Write unit tests with real coverage that hold up beyond the happy path

–Monitor logs, alerts, and error reporting, and fix infrastructure problems before a customer reports them

–Use AI coding tools (we use Claude Code) to move faster, and review every line of the output before it lands

What we're looking for: We are not fixed on years of experience. We are fixed on whether you can build and run production software on this stack.

–Strong C# / .NET and TypeScript, with solid Vue experience

–SQL Server: you can model data properly and diagnose a slow query yourself

–Hands-on Azure experience in a production environment

–Git and Azure DevOps

–Code that is structured, secure, and right-sized for the problem, and you know where that balance sits

–Comfortable being one of a handful of engineers, with the autonomy and the exposure that comes with it

–Strong communication and collaboration. You explain your thinking clearly, work well with people outside engineering, and own your mistakes as readily as your wins

–UK-based, with the existing right to work in the UK. This role is remote within the UK only. We are not able to sponsor visas or employ from outside the UK.

Nice to have

–Charting libraries, particularly eCharts

–End-user computing or IT support background, which gives you the context for what we're building

–A portfolio or public repos we can look at

How we work

Fully remote across the UK, with the whole team getting together at head office every so often, and we'd want you to enjoy that side of it too. Small team, short decision chains, no layers to route around. You will talk directly to the people who use the product and to the people who sell it. We back new tools and frameworks where they earn their place, and we'd want you making the case for the ones you think we should adopt.

Pay: £45,000.00-£75,000.00 per year

Application question(s):

* Are you currently based in the UK?
* Do you have the right to work in the UK without visa sponsorship, now and for the duration of employment?
* How many years of commercial experience do you have with C# / .NET?
* How many years of commercial experience do you have with Vue (2 or 3)?
* Have you built, managed, and deployed applications to Azure infrastructure?
* Which of these have you used in a production role? (Azure DevOps / SQL Server performance tuning / CI-CD pipeline ownership / eCharts or similar charting library)
* Briefly: describe a production incident you diagnosed and fixed yourself.

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London
